Repeated SHA512 reuses existing metadata ETag without revalidating stored bytes/size/contentType. Metadata primarykeyhash and mappings contain no contentType override; identical bytes uploaded under distinct contentTypes share first stored type. Source-only behavior, no HTTP/backend execution.
Multipart upload first completes buffer, then rereads whole bufferedobject for SHA512/MD5/size and calls same dedup path. No content-size/hash completeness oracle run.
Cleanup gets at most1000dangling hashes, deletes backend keys, then deletes DBmetadata for reported successes. Correctness depends on locksReleaseBlock, getDangling and deletion SQL not yetread.
ObjectStoreClient derives successes by removing explicitly failed keys from requested map. Backend iterable/result exception semantics unqualified; no Minio call performed.

Schemas use cascading hashforeignkey and unique user/bucket/filekey mapping. Source deletion removes mapping first and backend garbage collection separately; no whole operation durability/rollback proof.
